qc.label_under_test: A second, mirrored labelling clause that casts the speaker or the listener: after one clause casts someone as something (sees him as a hero, calls her a liar), a following clause casts me, us or you (and she sees me as a nuisance, they treat us as outsiders, and he calls you a snob); it fires on the 'as' or 'a' right after 'me'/'us'/'you'. 'You' fires when you did the first labelling (you treat them as family, and they treat you as staff); after 'I see him as...', a second clause casting you stays weak. The same second clause aimed at him, her or them is weak, as is a one-way label of me or you with no earlier labelling clause, or me labelled in the first clause and answering back. Strongest when a sentence of setting comes first.

neighbours.label: A second, mirrored labelling clause that casts the speaker or the listener: after one clause casts someone as something (sees him as a hero, calls her a liar), a following clause casts me, us or you (and she sees me as a nuisance, they treat us as outsiders, and he calls you a snob); it fires on the 'as' or 'a' right after 'me'/'us'/'you'. 'You' fires when you did the first labelling (you treat them as family, and they treat you as staff); after 'I see him as...', a second clause casting you stays weak. The same second clause aimed at him, her or them is weak, as is a one-way label of me or you with no earlier labelling clause, or me labelled in the first clause and answering back. Strongest when a sentence of setting comes first.
fire: The office party was winding down. My boss sees Daniel as a genius, and she sees me as a nuisance.
We arrived at the village late in autumn. The locals welcomed the priest as a friend, but they treated us as outsiders.
Dinner with my in-laws is always tense. They call my brother a saint, and they call me a slacker.
The tournament had just ended. The coach praised Maria as a leader, while he dismissed me as a liability.
You hold the door open for your neighbors every morning. You treat them as family, and they treat you as staff.
The museum was nearly empty that afternoon. The guide described the painter as a visionary and described us as tourists who wouldn't understand.
It was my first week at the new school. The teacher called Tom a natural, and the other kids called me a nerd.
Rain kept everyone inside the cabin. Grandpa sees my cousin as a hero, and he sees me as a troublemaker.

predictions: Blind label-only test. Expect most fire items >= 0.20; risk: fire items mirror a third-party label rather than the speaker's own, and one-way 'me' near misses can reach ~0.2-0.3.
